title: Sea Front Deluxe Supreme
description:
All the rooms are designed to provide you best accommodation according to your need and budget. Sea front Deluxe Supreme rooms are to those who want to see the sea and feel the waves. From this room you can enjoy sunset lying in your bed. These rooms offer the best sea view in Cox′s Bazar.

Every rooms are equipped with 32″ LED TV. One king size bed, local & IDD Phone, well equipped toilet with running hot and cold water, split type air conditioner and the best balcony in Cox′s Bazar.

title: Presidential Suite
description:
These Suites are on the top Floor of the building having sea facing view. The Suites are well decorated and furnished. Every Suite consists of two couple bedded rooms (king size bed), a dining room, a kitchen, the best sea view balcony in Cox′s Bazara from where one can enjoy the Sea, the Sunset & the waves of the Sea.

Rooms are equipped with 32″ Flat TV, ID Phone, provision for supplying of hot and cold water, Split type air conditioner and a well equipped toilet with bath tab.

title: Super Deluxe Triple
description:
This is for small family, all of these rooms offer triple accommodation with one Queen size bed and one single bed with private balcony from where one can enjoy the sea from side facilitated with 32″ LED TV, local & IDD Phone, well equipped
toilet with running hot and cold water, split type air conditioner.
